units: <cite ref="Nedarim 56a:5">Ib. 56ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>הכופה את מִטָּתוֹ</he>, v. <cite ref="K01007"><he>כָּפָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Nedarim 56b:1">Ib. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ המיוחדת לכלים</he> a bed designated for the exhibit of garments (not slept upon); <cite ref="Sanhedrin 20a:13">Snh. 20ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 3:1">Ber. III, 1</cite> <he>נושאי המ׳</he> those carrying the bier; a. fr.—<he>מ׳ של גילה</he>, <he>מ׳ גלילתא</he>, v. <cite ref="C00883"><he>גִּלָּה</he></cite>, <cite ref="C00950"><he>גְּלִילְתָּא</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 36:2">Lev. R. s. 36</cite> <he>שהיתה מִטָּתוֹ שלימה</he> his bed was perfect, his children were all righteous; Sifra B’ḥuck., Par. 2, ch. VIII.
<cite ref="Pesachim 56a:7">Pes. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>שמא … יש במִיטָּתִי פסול</he> perhaps there is a blemish in my family; a. e.
